normalization_plan.reason: The regulator supplied price is only used to write the peg, so it normalises into setPeg.
The purchase amount solely drives the burn and premium of purchaseCoupons.
The epoch argument only selects the coupon bucket inside redeemCoupons.
The coupon amount is fully consumed by redeemCoupons.
The recipient address is only used as the credit target of transferCoupons.
The transfer amount is entirely consumed by transferCoupons.
The deposited value is only used to pull shares and credit staged balance in deposit.
The bonded value is only consumed by bond.
The candidate address is only used to select or create a proposal inside vote.
The candidate address is only forwarded to upgradeTo by commit.
The implementation address is only stored and delegatecalled by upgradeTo.
The new supply value is entirely consumed by the increaseSupply distribution logic.
The local coupon amount is produced and consumed entirely within purchaseCoupons.
The local penalty amount is produced and consumed within redeemCoupons.
The local net amount is the value handed to redeemToAccount.
The local phantom amount is produced and consumed within bond.
The local claimable amount is produced and consumed within unbond.
The local redeemable amount is produced and consumed within increaseSupply.
The local oracle price is produced and consumed within Regulator.step.
The local timestamp offset is produced and consumed within couponRedemptionPenalty.
The local coupon age is produced and consumed within couponRedemptionPenalty.
The local excess redeemable is produced and consumed within expireCouponsForEpoch.
